surprise_tactic.trigger: player chose B at mr0 and mr1
surprise_tactic.line: Monday. In writing. You said that to me already. Twice. Do you think saying it a third time makes it truer? Explain to me why Monday.

tell.reading: It wants a reason. Any reason.
tell.false_positive: It's a fair question. In a normal conversation you'd answer it.

surprise_tactic.correct_response: B again, unchanged, or CALL: 'That's bait. Monday.'

mr_win.line_default: You're very sure of yourself for someone who has explained themselves in every room.
